A confirmation is a statement by the General Staff, SBU, HUR, SSO, Unmanned Systems Forces, OC South, StratCom or Valerii Zaluzhnyi; the archive so far contains only General Staff confirmations (in 2022 sometimes the Commander-in-Chief): 2022 — occupied territories only, as the General Staff did not confirm strikes inside russia then; 2023 — the General Staff rarely named targets; 2024 — January–June only; 2025 — not collected yet; 2026 — January–September, the most complete.
